description: Unofficial Lord Death fan-art companion from Soul Eater, depicting the friendly academy headmaster. Original gentle choreography includes aligning and stamping small exercise books, folding a paper star into a paper ball, ringing a miniature desk bell, a legless robe bob and directional gliding with alternating hands and robe folds. No scythe, attack or injury. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
